roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This pivotal role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, policy development, and educational efforts to maintain a healthy and secure environment. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for a passionate professional to make an immediate impact.

This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and the vital contributions you will make to our facility. Join a team committed to excellence and resident well-being.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development or nursing education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
